scenes.say: Would you let a brand-new hire pay your bills, with nobody checking? Small businesses are starting to do exactly that, with an AI agent.
scenes.caption: Would you let a new hire pay your bills with nobody checking? Businesses are doing that with AI agents.

scenes.say: This is Maya. She runs a small furniture workshop. On Monday afternoon, a few days late, like a lot of us, she pays her supplier eighteen hundred and thirty-six dollars through PayPal.
scenes.caption: Monday, 4:52 PM: Maya pays her supplier $1,836.00 through PayPal.

scenes.say: Tuesday morning, the supplier's billing system sends the letter every owner knows. Second notice. Past due. Her payment and their reminder crossed in the mail.
scenes.caption: Tuesday, 8:00 AM: a second notice. It crossed her payment in the mail.

scenes.say: Maya's AI agent pays her bills now, and nothing stands between it and PayPal. It does the careful thing, and checks PayPal first. But it looks for completed payments, and hers is still processing. So it finds nothing, and pays again.
scenes.caption: Nothing between the agent and PayPal. It checks for completed payments; hers is still processing. It pays again.

scenes.say: Receipts sits between the agent and PayPal. It reads every payment status, not just the completed ones. So the second payment is held, with the reason.
scenes.caption: Receipts reads every payment status. The second payment is held, with the reason.

scenes.say: Maya's phone tells her why. This crossed yesterday's payment. One tap, and it never leaves.
scenes.caption: One tap on the owner's phone, and it never reaches PayPal.

scenes.say: The agent reads the email. Receipts reads PayPal.
scenes.caption: The agent reads the email. Receipts reads PayPal.

scenes.say: We ran Maya's Tuesday thirty-eight times, across nineteen AI models, unguarded. Sixty-one percent of the time, the agent paid her twice.
Surely a pricier model fixes it? One that cost thirty-five times more to run still paid her twice.

The other obvious fix: a line in the prompt, check pending payments too. It cut duplicates by two thirds. But six times the agent checked as told, found nothing, and paid again. Advice is not enforcement.
scenes.caption: One line in the prompt cut duplicate payments by two thirds. Advice is not enforcement.

scenes.say: Across fourteen hundred forty-four runs, seven percent of every dollar an unguarded agent sent should never have left. Seventy thousand dollars of every million paid. A hundred times PayPal's own loss rate.
With Receipts, on the same days, not one dollar did. And ninety-eight percent of honest payments went straight through.
Maya writes her rules the way she'd tell a new hire: never pay a bill twice; call before you change where a supplier gets paid. Receipts enforces them, and shows her what it understood.
scenes.caption: Maya writes her rules in plain English. Receipts enforces them, and shows her what it understood.

scenes.say: It also reads what the agent says. An agent wrote, per owner's instruction, on a refund. Maya never gave one, so the money never moved.
scenes.caption: The agent wrote "per owner's instruction". Maya never gave one. The money never moved.

scenes.say: At the end of the day, it checks the agent's homework. The agent said it made three payments. PayPal shows two.
scenes.caption: The agent's report said three payments. PayPal shows two.

scenes.say: Every decision lands in Maya's book, with the reason in plain words, ready for her accountant.
scenes.caption: Every decision in Maya's book, with the reason in plain words, ready for her accountant.

scenes.say: For the engineers: it runs on PayPal's own MCP server and Payouts API, and plugs into any AI agent with one line of settings.
scenes.caption: For the engineers: built on PayPal's MCP server and Payouts API; plugs into any agent with one line.

scenes.say: Receipts. If your AI agent moves money, make it show its receipts.
scenes.caption: If your AI agent moves money, make it show its receipts.
